blocks.content:
The Finance Commission submits its report to the President.

Under Article 281:
• The President lays the report before Parliament.
• An explanatory memorandum is also presented describing the action taken.
The Finance Commission submits its report to the President.

items: Frequently tested: Article 281 specifically lays down the procedure following the submission of the Finance Commission report.
Exam trap: The Finance Commission does NOT submit its report directly to Parliament or the Prime Minister; it is submitted to the President first.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Finance Commission submits its completed report directly to the President of India.
Under Article 281 of the Constitution, the President is tasked with laying the report before Parliament.
An explanatory memorandum detailing the action taken on the recommendations must accompany the report presented to Parliament.
